Metadata.siteDescription: Marketplace for hunting opportunities in Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Czechia and Poland.

HomePage.title: Find hunting opportunities
HomePage.intro: Hunting leases, hunting permits, driven hunts, trophy hunts and hunting helpers in Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Czechia and Poland.

login.title: Sign in or register
login.intro: Enter your email address. We will send you a link and a sign-in code. No password needed.
login.sentText: If the address {email} can be used, we have sent you an email. Click the link in it or enter the 6-digit code.
login.codeInvalid: The code is invalid or has expired.
login.otherEmail: Use a different email address or request a new email
login.termsHint: New accounts are asked to accept the terms of use after the first sign-in.
login.privacyHint: How we process your email address is explained in the <link>privacy policy</link>.

confirm.title: Confirm sign-in
confirm.text: To finish signing in, confirm with the button.
confirm.invalid: This link is invalid or has expired. Enter the code from the email or request a new email.

admins.title: Admins
admins.intro: Admins can review listings and appoint or remove other admins. Every change requires a fresh code from your authenticator app and is recorded in the audit log.
